subject: Unidimensional and multidimensional IIF / TIF in mirt

messages.author: 3c35205a55cd2917
messages.subject: Unidimensional and multidimensional IIF / TIF in mirt
parts:
Dear all,

If I'm not mistaken the IIF and TIF in the Mirt package can be calculated with the itemsinfo and testinfo functions,
as well as areainfo.
Iteminfo and testinfo functions calculate IIF and TIF on Theta with a certain range (eg -4 to 4),
while the areainfo function calculates the area under the information curve in Theta with a certain range (eg -4 to 4)
and total area (range Theta -10 to 10).

Based on the examples, iteminfo and testinfo functions can be used to calculate unidimensional and multidimensional 
IIF and TIF, but the area offo can only be used to calculate IIF and TIF dimensions.
Is my opinion correct?
Are there examples or references using the areainfo function for multidimensional IRT?

Greetings
